practice.title: Daily Life · Vivienda
practice.passage:
Subject: Housing renewal — deadline reminder

If you wish to remain in university housing next year, you must submit the renewal form by March 31. Students who do not renew by this date will lose their priority and be placed on the general waiting list. A deposit of €250 is required with the form; it will be refunded when you move out, provided that the room is left in good condition. Students who plan to study abroad next year may request a temporary hold on their room.

items.q: What happens to students who miss the March 31 deadline?
options: They lose priority and join the waiting list

items.q: When will the deposit be refunded?
options: When the student moves out, if the room is in good condition

items.q: What can students who plan to study abroad request?
options: A temporary hold on their room

practice.title: Daily Life · Cafetería
practice.passage:
CAMPUS CAFÉ — Reusable Cup Program
Bring your own cup and receive 20 cents off every drink. Or borrow one of our reusable cups for a €1 deposit; return it to any collection point on campus and get your deposit back. Cups must be returned within 14 days. The program does not apply to bottled drinks.

items.q: How much is the deposit for a borrowed cup?

practice.title: Daily Life · Mensaje de grupo
practice.passage:
Hi everyone,

Quick update about our study group. Because several of you have exams on Thursday, I'm moving our meeting from Wednesday at 7 p.m. to Friday at 5 p.m., in the same room. If Friday doesn't work for you, please reply by tomorrow noon so I can find another time. Also, please bring the problem sets we discussed; we'll compare solutions. — Dana

items.q: Why is the meeting being moved?
options: Several members have exams on Thursday

items.q: What should someone do if Friday does not work?
items.explain: Responder antes de mañana al mediodía.
